incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED: PagerDuty PD-12345 - high 5xx rate on embeddings-eu (service: embeddings). Spike started ~03:41 UTC. Suspected kv-cache eviction + pod churn. https://pagerduty.local/incidents/PD-12345
Sam Patel: Ack. I'm taking first ownership. pinging @Anika for infra scale, @Chen for telemetry/debug.
Anika Rao: On it. Quick summary: autoscaler hit max, pods OOM/killed due to kvcache growth. I'll scale EU pool and tune eviction.
Anika Rao: Running scale now: `kubectl scale deployment embeddings-eu --replicas=6 -n prod`
Chen Li: Telemetry shows kvcache miss rate jumped to ~42% at 03:41. Traces point to a hot prefix from a few customers. Recommend enabling fallback routing to us-dedicated while we stabilise.
Priya K: Customer impact note: ~12% 5xx for EU requests over last 4m. One enterprise reported degraded search UX. Drafting short PSA for affected customers.
Maya (SRE): If we need a fast mitigation we can route EU non-gold traffic to us-dedicated pool. I can flip a route at the gateway.
Maya (SRE): Example: `curl -X POST https://gateway.internal/route -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTE_TOKEN' -d '{"service":"embeddings","region":"eu","fallback":"us-dedicated"}'`
Sam Patel: I'll monitor after the scale. If 5xx < 5% in 5m I'll keep ownership and then hand back to Anika. @incident-bot set owner=Sam Patel until 1764532400 please.
incident-bot: Owner updated -> Sam Patel. Notifying PagerDuty responders and updating the incident timeline.
Chen Li: Quick logs snippet:
```
ERROR 03:41:12 kvcache.cpp: eviction triggered size=12.8GB threshold=10GB
WARN 03:41:23 pod/embeddings-1 OOMKilled
INFO 03:42:05 autoscaler: scale up triggered (replicas 4 -> 6)
```
Anika Rao: Scale completed, pods 6/6 ready, CPU back to normal, eviction spikes reduced. Continuing to monitor KV hit/miss and tail latency.
Sam Patel: Observed 5xx down to ~3% over last 2m. Keeping owner until PD snooze window ends. I'll post a short customer-facing status if stable.
Priya K: Sending PSA to tenants affected (short, non-technical). Will paste here for review in 2m. :thumbsup:
Maya (SRE): If we see another uptick we should enable the gateway fallback and warn support to open temporary rate-limiting for noisy customers.
Sam Patel: Agreed. Thanks all — will update in 10m or earlier if things regress. :white_check_mark:
